memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 14 June 2026

Portfolio is down 14.3% ($1,426 on equity basis) after 21 closed trades. The dominant driver of losses is MOMENTUM, which has generated -$1,249 on 18 trades at a 28% win rate — well below any reasonable break-even threshold. The pattern is unmistakable: MOMENTUM is systematically entering on YES sides of geopolitical/news-driven markets (Iran deal, Hormuz, invasion) where sentiment spikes reverse sharply. Entry prices are often 0.16–0.80 with model predictions clustered at 0.56–0.62, suggesting the signal is chasing recent price action into overextended positions on thin, volatile markets. Three trades on 'US x Iran permanent peace deal by June 15' were all losers — a concentration failure that predates the prior analyst's MOMENTUM disable. The correct call to disable MOMENTUM was made last session; that must be maintained.

SMART_CONSENSUS produced one trade, a -$385 loss on a CS:GO match with a 62% model prediction that hit stop-loss immediately — sample too small to judge but the stake sizing ($1,000 at prior kellyMult) was egregious for an untested engine. SHORT_FAVORITE shows +$58 on 2 trades; insufficient data but directionally positive. Brier score of 0.298 confirms systematic miscalibration — predictions are overconfident relative to outcomes.

Current config (MOMENTUM off, SMART_CONSENSUS off, kellyMult 0.10, pMin 0.62) is appropriate. I am raising maxEventExposure floor to 500 (already at minimum) and keeping sizing conservative. No changes warranted; allow SHORT_FAVORITE, VOLUME_SPIKE, and ELITE_FOLLOW to accumulate evidence before re-enabling anything.
observations: MOMENTUM engine: 18 trades, 28% win rate, -$1,249 PnL — systematic losses, correctly disabled last session
SMART_CONSENSUS: single trade, -$385 loss, $1,000 stake was oversized for an unproven engine at old kellyMult
SHORT_FAVORITE: 2 trades, 1 win, +$58 — directionally positive, too small to conclude anything
VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW: zero trades — no evidence base yet
Brier score 0.298 indicates poor calibration; model predictions (0.56–0.62) are not predictive of actual outcomes
Heavy concentration in Iran/geopolitical YES momentum trades — 7+ trades on correlated themes, serial stop-loss hits
Open positions: Knicks/Spurs NBA Finals bets are correlated (one team must win), net exposure on this event needs monitoring
Israel airspace SHORT_FAVORITE position at 0.9915 current vs 0.835 entry — near resolution, looking healthy
Equity at $8,574 vs $10,000 start; further drawdown risks breaching psychological floor requiring strategy review
No new trades should enter until VOLUME_SPIKE or ELITE_FOLLOW demonstrate signal or SHORT_FAVORITE accumulates 10+ trades
changeReasoning: No parameter changes from current config. MOMENTUM is correctly disabled given catastrophic 28% win rate and -$1,249 PnL across 18 trades with clear systematic failure mode. SMART_CONSENSUS disabled pending more data — one trade is not a sample. pMin at 0.62 is appropriately strict for a depleted bankroll. kellyMult at 0.10 (minimum) is correct given miscalibration evidenced by Brier 0.298. maxExposure at 0.35 limits further drawdown. maxEventExposure at 500 minimum prevents repeat of oversized SMART_CONSENSUS stake. VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW remain enabled to allow data collection, but with minimal sizing these pose limited risk. Changing parameters on noise would be irresponsible given small per-engine sample sizes.
riskFlags: Knicks YES ($200) and Spurs NO ($800) are on the SAME NBA Finals event — combined $1,000 exposure on one event, net short Knicks; if Knicks win both positions lose; review event exposure logic
Brier score 0.298 is dangerously high — model probability estimates are unreliable; consider whether pMin threshold of 0.62 is even meaningful given miscalibration
Bank has declined 14.3% in early trading; another similar drawdown period would require fundamental strategy suspension

MOMENTUM signal appears to be systematically entering on sentiment spikes in thin geopolitical markets — the feature set likely has no real edge here; if MOMENTUM is ever re-enabled, geopolitical/news categories should be filtered

Iran-related trades showed serial correlation (7 positions on related markets) — event exposure limits were likely bypassed due to different market titles; maxEventExposure by underlying topic needs enforcement
